tools.name: record_catch
tools.description: Record one catch in your logbook: date, species, place, and optionally length, weight, method, weather and water temperature. Returns the stored entry, or the list of errors that prevented storing it.

tools.name: list_entries
tools.description: List the entries stored in your own logbook, newest first. Entries belonging to other users are never returned.

tools.name: catch_summary
tools.description: Count what is in your logbook: totals, longest and heaviest, per species, per place and per month. Every number is counted from your entries; nothing is estimated.
